**Corollary 4** {#cor-1 .statement tag=K201 env=corollary}

A graph in which each vertex has degree $3$ has an even number of vertices.

**Proof.** {#proof-3 .proof tag=P203}

Apply [Theorem 3](#thm-1): all the vertices have odd degree.

**Question 5** {#q-1 .problem tag=Q201 env=question}

Which numbers are the degree sequence of some graph? See [Theorem 3](#thm-1) for one condition.
